title: Nvidia is not considering rehiring Jensen Huang, and Amazon's data center gets bought
summary:
Deirdre Bosa discusses Nvidia (NVDA), claiming they are not considering bringing back Jensen Huang, Amazon's (AMZN) data centers being bought by Blackstone (BX), and Apple (AAPL) launching a study on how people use AI for health.

Deirdre Bosa then sits down with Niles Investment Management Founder Dan Niles to talk about the AI trade proving itself beyond Jensen Huang, Neoclouds could be the biggest loser post-Jensen, and the Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) IPO.

'Deirdre Bosa Live' airs every day at 4 p.m. Tune in daily to hear how the latest developments in AI and technology are reshaping companies, industries, and the global economy.

title: Delta CEO: Most airlines touting Starlink “haven’t even started yet”
summary:
“This is about the total experience, and customers are not choosing airlines based on the Wi-Fi.”

At the F500 Innovation Forum, Delta CEO Ed Bastian told Alyson Shontell that the airline helped Elon Musk’s satellite Wi-Fi “get started in aviation,” but the two sides “just couldn’t come to agreement on a business model.”

title: Boeing (BA) ULA Rocket Failure Halts Deployment Of 40 Broadband Satellites
summary: Boeing (NYSE:BA) part-owned United Launch Alliance reported a rocket failure while carrying 40 Amazon satellites on a recent mission. The malfunction interrupted deployment of Amazon's planned space broadband constellation, delaying service timelines for the technology project. The incident raises execution questions for Boeing's space joint venture and its ability to secure future commercial launch contracts.
